scope: Future Korzh80nm 775nm/1550nm relative-delay runs; not the current static non-photon controls
authorized_change: Time horizon and stopping rule only
signal_meaning: Load output voltage from the full thesis circuit; not the internal mesoscopic voltage

event.selection: First upward interpolated threshold crossing that meets the registered confirmation criterion
event.reported_trigger_time: Interpolated crossing time, not the later confirmation time
event.already_above_threshold_or_missing_basel: No invented earlier crossing; explicit unavailable/invalid-initial-event classification

stopping.no_crossing_by_ceiling: Right-censored observation; do not assign a detected latency
stopping.numerical_failure: Numerical failure, separate from physical non-detection censoring
stopping.confirmed_crossing_but_margin_cut_short: Retain valid crossing and latency; report incomplete post-trigger margin

color_pair.clock_origin: Transfer to the model, with the omitted color-dependent optical-cascade delay still explicit

forbidden_shortcuts: Removal or freezing of circuit states
Resetting the pulse tail or populations
Changing material, geometry or boundary parameters solely to shorten the horizon
Treating an unobserved crossing as latency equal to the time ceiling
Silently adopting existing default100uV as the physical experimental threshold

existing_code_audit.current_latency_stop: Confirmed peak plus post_peak_safety_s; different from trigger plus margin

later_user_input_if_sources_insufficient: Output threshold and polarity in the represented readout chain
Finite observation ceiling when no trigger occurs
